quality.review_scope: Main and selected SI source evidence independently audited; stated sample and measurement limits remain in force. Original CdSe hot-injection quantities and separate physical batch IDs not reported by this source. Main Figure 3b,c is a separate 2.7 nm solvent series at 1 mM DPA and 532 nm; it is not a Table 1 optical-assay row (1.7 mM DPA).
missing_fields: Upstream CdSe hot-injection core recipe is only cited, not given; starting-core provenance is incomplete.
The source reports nominal size without stating the diameter measurement method or a new post-exchange size measurement.
Ligand exchange temperature and 9-ACA stock preparation charges/order unreported.
The main paper calls 0.0216 M a final concentration and also a 3:11 solvent solubility limit; effective concentration after extra toluene is unresolved.
Individual physical batches and recipe-to-optical-sample IDs are not supplied; Table 1 links at named size-series level.
No measured product atomistic coordinates, TEM morphology or exact 9-ACA surface geometry.
conflicts: Main p.3 says 9-ACA density around 0.1/nm², whereas SI p.2 Table S1 spans 0.090–1.128/nm², including 1.128 at 2.7 nm; retain both scopes.
Main p.4 Table 1 labels 3.7 nm; SI p.2 Table S1 labels 3.8 nm. The SI 3.8 result is not assigned to the main 3.7 record.

Main p.4 Table 1 gives the 2.7 nm sensitizer PLQY as 11.0%, whereas main p.3 Figure 4a and SI p.4 Figure S2 visible legends label 11.2%. Both reported values are retained; rounding versus a distinct assay/batch is unresolved.
